title: 10 Habits of Highly Productive People
text: Ultimate guide to productivity, motivation and mindset. Here is why you should build a morning routine that changes your life. Life hacks for ultimate productivity. Your motivation is a skill you can build.

title: Why You Should Wake Up at 5AM

title: spf13/cobra: A CLI library for Go
text: A framework for building command line applications. This tutorial walks through how to build a CLI with subcommands, how to install the tool, and how to scaffold a new project. Includes documentation, tests, and a starter you can clone. You will learn how to implement help text, config loading, and error handling by the end.
